'''Kazunari Dōmen''' (born September 24, 1953) is a Japanese chemist and materials scientist specializing in heterogeneous catalysis, photocatalysis, and solar-driven water splitting.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Kazunari Domen has been named a 2024 Clarivate Citation Laureate in Chemistry. |url=https://www.chemistry.or.jp/en/news/2024/kazunari-domenhas-2024clarivate-citation-laureate-chemistry.html|access-date=2025-01-15 |website=[[The Chemical Society of Japan]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=exaly.com |title=Photocatalytic Activity |url=https://exaly.com/topic/14446/photocatalytic-activity |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=exaly.com |language=en}}</ref> He is a University Professor in the Office of University Professors at the [[University of Tokyo]] and a Distinguished University Professor at the Institute for Aqua Regeneration, Shinshu University.<ref name=":1" />

== Early life and education ==
Domen was born in 1953 in Japan. He studied at the University of Tokyo, receiving a bachelor's degree in 1976, a master's degree from its School of Science in 1979, and a Ph.D. in chemistry in 1982 with his thesis ''Photocatalytic Reaction on Some Semiconductor Powders''.<ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Prof. K. Domen |url=https://www.domen.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/english/domen/dome_profile_e.html |website=t.u-tokyo.ac.jp |access-date=15 January 2025}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Kazunari Domen |url=https://www.rsc.org/people/kazunari-domen |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=Royal Society of Chemistry |language=en}}</ref>

After completing his doctorate, Domen joined the Chemical Resources Laboratory at Tokyo Institute of Technology as an assistant professor in 1982. He subsequently became an associate professor in 1990 and professor in 1996. During this period, he spent time as a visiting scientist at the IBM Almaden Research Center in California.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kudo |first=Akihiko |last2=Sakata |first2=Yoshihisa |last3=Kondo |first3=Junko N. |last4=Hara |first4=Michikazu |last5=Kubota |first5=Jun |last6=Ikeda |first6=Shigeru |last7=Takata |first7=Tsuyoshi |last8=Abe |first8=Ryu |last9=Takagaki |first9=Atsushi |last10=Hisatomi |first10=Takashi |date=2023-05-19 |title=A Career in Catalysis: Kazunari Domen |url=https://doi.org/10.1021/acscatal.3c00951 |journal=ACS Catalysis |volume=13 |issue=10 |pages=6934–6955 |doi=10.1021/acscatal.3c00951 |issn=2155-5435|doi-access=free }}</ref> 

== Career ==
In 2004, Domen was appointed assistant professor at the [[Tokyo Institute of Technology]]. He stayed as a postdoctoral fellow at the IBM Almaden Research Center in [[San José, California]] in 1985/86. He was promoted to associate professor at the Tokyo Institute of Technology in 1990 and received a full professorship in 1996. Dōmen returned to his alma mater in 2004 as a professor.<ref name=":0" /> Together with Takashi Hisatomi, he has also been running a research laboratory at [[Shinshu University|Shinshū University]] since 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=Domen-Hisatomi Laboratory |url=https://www.shinshu-u.ac.jp/institution/rism/domen-hisatomi-lab/en/ |website=shinshu-u.ac.jp |access-date=15 January 2025 |language=en |date=14 January 2025}}</ref>

He began a cross-appointment with Shinshu University in 2017 and subsequently held positions at the university's Center for Energy & Environmental Science and Research Initiative for Supra-Materials. He became a Distinguished University Professor at Shinshu University's Institute for Aqua Regeneration in 2025.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Kazunari Domen：Photocatalytic Production of Solar Hydrogen and Fuels from Water-State Key Laboratory of Physical Chemistry of Solid Surfaces |url=https://pcoss.xmu.edu.cn/en/info/1094/8952.htm |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=pcoss.xmu.edu.cn}}</ref>

Domen has also been involved in the organization of scientific conferences. In 2018, he served as chairperson of TOCAT8, the eighth Tokyo Conference on Advanced Catalytic Science and Technology, held in Yokohama.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TOCAT8: Information |url=https://www.shokubai.org/tocat8/information.html |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=www.shokubai.org}}</ref> 

He has served as a reviewer for journals including ''Nature Materials'', ''Nature Catalysis'', ''Nature Energy'', ''Nature Communications'', ''Energy & Environmental Science'', ''Chemical Science'', ''Joule'', ''Journal of the American Chemical Society'', ''Angewandte Chemie International Edition'', and ''ACS Catalysis''.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kudo |first=Akihiko |last2=Sakata |first2=Yoshihisa |last3=Kondo |first3=Junko N. |last4=Hara |first4=Michikazu |last5=Kubota |first5=Jun |last6=Ikeda |first6=Shigeru |last7=Takata |first7=Tsuyoshi |last8=Abe |first8=Ryu |last9=Takagaki |first9=Atsushi |last10=Hisatomi |first10=Takashi |date=2023-05-19 |title=A Career in Catalysis: Kazunari Domen |url=https://doi.org/10.1021/acscatal.3c00951 |journal=ACS Catalysis |volume=13 |issue=10 |pages=6934–6955 |doi=10.1021/acscatal.3c00951 |issn=2155-5435|doi-access=free }}</ref>

== Research ==
Domen and his collaborators developed particulate photocatalytic systems intended to make solar hydrogen production scalable. In 2016, his group reported particulate photocatalyst sheets capable of producing hydrogen and oxygen with a solar-to-hydrogen energy conversion efficiency exceeding 1 percent. Subsequent research addressed the durability and efficiency of photocatalysts and the design of reaction systems for large-scale deployment.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Wang |first=Qian |last2=Hisatomi |first2=Takashi |last3=Jia |first3=Qingxin |last4=Tokudome |first4=Hiromasa |last5=Zhong |first5=Miao |last6=Wang |first6=Chizhong |last7=Pan |first7=Zhenhua |last8=Takata |first8=Tsuyoshi |last9=Nakabayashi |first9=Mamiko |last10=Shibata |first10=Naoya |last11=Li |first11=Yanbo |last12=Sharp |first12=Ian D. |last13=Kudo |first13=Akihiko |last14=Yamada |first14=Taro |last15=Domen |first15=Kazunari |date=2016 |title=Scalable water splitting on particulate photocatalyst sheets with a solar-to-hydrogen energy conversion efficiency exceeding 1 |url=https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26950596 |journal=Nature Materials |volume=15 |issue=6 |pages=611–615 |doi=10.1038/nmat4589 |issn=1476-4660 |pmid=26950596}}</ref>

His group also developed a 100-square-meter solar hydrogen production system using particulate photocatalysts. The work demonstrated the possibility of scaling photocatalytic water splitting beyond laboratory-scale experiments and became an important component of Domen's research into practical solar hydrogen production.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nishiyama |first=Hiroshi |last2=Yamada |first2=Taro |last3=Nakabayashi |first3=Mamiko |last4=Maehara |first4=Yoshiki |last5=Yamaguchi |first5=Masaharu |last6=Kuromiya |first6=Yasuko |last7=Nagatsuma |first7=Yoshie |last8=Tokudome |first8=Hiromasa |last9=Akiyama |first9=Seiji |last10=Watanabe |first10=Tomoaki |last11=Narushima |first11=Ryoichi |last12=Okunaka |first12=Sayuri |last13=Shibata |first13=Naoya |last14=Takata |first14=Tsuyoshi |last15=Hisatomi |first15=Takashi |date=2021-10-01 |title=Photocatalytic solar hydrogen production from water on a 100-m2 scale |url=https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03907-3 |journal=Nature |volume=598 |issue=7880 |pages=304–307 |doi=10.1038/s41586-021-03907-3 |issn=1476-4687 |pmid=34433207|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

In more recent research, Domen has focused on the materials and systems required for large-scale solar hydrogen production, including photocatalysts with higher solar-to-hydrogen conversion efficiencies, improved durability, reactor design, and gas separation. A 2025 review in ''Nature Reviews Materials'' examined materials and systems for large-scale photocatalytic water splitting, including work associated with Domen's research group.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Hisatomi |first=Takashi |last2=Yamada |first2=Taro |last3=Nishiyama |first3=Hiroshi |last4=Takata |first4=Tsuyoshi |last5=Domen |first5=Kazunari |date=2025 |title=Author Correction: Materials and systems for large-scale photocatalytic water splitting |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41578-025-00859-2 |journal=Nature Reviews Materials |language=en |publisher=Nature Publishing Group |volume=10 |issue=12 |pages=964–964 |doi=10.1038/s41578-025-00859-2 |issn=2058-8437}}</ref>

In 2025, Domen published a major review on particulate photocatalysts for large-scale green hydrogen production. The article examined semiconductor photocatalysts, cocatalysts, particulate systems, visible-light response, panel reactors, and hydrogen and oxygen separation.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Domen |first=Kazunari |date=2025-11-11 |title=Particulate photocatalysts for water splitting to produce green hydrogen on a large scale |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/397499307_Particulate_photocatalysts_for_water_splitting_to_produce_green_hydrogen_on_a_large_scale |journal=Proceedings of the Japan Academy, Series B |volume=101 |pages=564–586 |doi=10.2183/pjab.101.035}}</ref> He was a co-author of a Nature paper published in August 2026 reporting photocatalytic water splitting using a two-dimensional polymer with out-of-plane carrier flow.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Zhuzhang |first=Hangyu |last2=Yu |first2=Zhiyang |last3=Liang |first3=Xiaocong |last4=Lin |first4=Lihua |last5=Fu |first5=Xianzhi |last6=Domen |first6=Kazunari |last7=Wang |first7=Xinchen |date=2026 |title=Photocatalytic water splitting by 2D polymer with out-of-plane carrier flow |url=https://ideas.repec.org//a/nat/nature/v656y2026i8128d10.1038_s41586-026-10866-0.html |journal=Nature |language=en |publisher=Nature |volume=656 |issue=8128 |pages=624–629}}</ref>

* 1990 – Encouragement Prize, Catalysis Society of Japan.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |title=堂免 一成 ドウメン カズナリ  (Kazunari Domen) |url=https://researchmap.jp/read0180713}}</ref> 
* 1991 – Catalyst Preparation Chemistry Award, Catalysis Society of Japan.<ref name=":4" /> 
* 2007 – Catalysis Society of Japan Award.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Global Innovation Ecosystem 2008 |url=https://www.jst.go.jp/crds/sympo/gies2008/speakers/30.html |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=www.jst.go.jp}}</ref> 
* 2011 – Chemical Society of Japan Award.<ref name=":3" /> 
* 2014 – Lewis Lecturer, University of Cambridge.<ref>{{Cite web |title=talks.cam : Solar-fuels production from water using photocatalysts |url=https://talks.cam.ac.uk/talk/index/47279/ |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=talks.cam.ac.uk}}</ref> 
* 2018 – Japan Petroleum Institute Award.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Kazunari Domen from University of Tokyo Visits IMR----Institute of Metal Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences |url=http://english.imr.cas.cn/news/newsrelease/201906/t20190611_211279.html |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=english.imr.cas.cn}}</ref> 
* 2018 – Japanese Photochemistry Association Lectureship Award.<ref>{{Cite web |title=光化学協会 |url=https://photochemistry.jp/award/lectureship.html |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=photochemistry.jp}}</ref> 
* 2019 – Lee Hsun Lecture Award, Institute of Metal Research, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Kazunari Domen from University of Tokyo Visits IMR----Institute of Metal Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences |url=http://english.imr.cas.cn/news/newsrelease/201906/t20190611_211279.html |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=english.imr.cas.cn}}</ref> 
* 2019 – Advance of Catalysis Award, Asia-Pacific Association of Catalysis Societies (APACS).<ref name=":3" /> 
* 2020 – Honorary Fellow, Chinese Chemical Society.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chinese Chemical Society |url=https://www.chinesechemsoc.org/do/10.5555/f3c10f80-e6a7-4a30-b90a-35a536c0d4dd/ |access-date= |website=Chinese Chemical Society |language=en |doi=}}</ref> 
* 2022 – Contribution Award, Japan Society of Coordination Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web |title=「貢献賞」受賞者一覧 {{!}} 錯体化学会 Japan Society of Coordination Chemistry |url=http://www.sakutai.jp/awardees/award-9 |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=www.sakutai.jp |language=ja}}</ref> 
* 2022 – Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry.<ref name=":2" /> 
* 2022 – EIC Horizon Prize, "Fuel from the Sun: Artificial Photosynthesis." The prize recognized a research team that developed an artificial-photosynthesis system for producing usable fuel from sunlight, water and carbon dioxide.<ref name=":3" /> 
* 2024 – Heinz Heinemann Award, International Association of Catalysis Societies, for contributions to photocatalytic water splitting, solar hydrogen production, and large-scale green hydrogen production.<ref name=":3" /> 
* 2024 – [[Clarivate Citation Laureates|Clarivate Citation Laureate]] (2024),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Clarivate Reveals Citation Laureates 2024 |url=https://clarivate.com/news/clarivate-reveals-citation-laureates-2024/ |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=clarivate.com |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |language=en-US}}</ref> for "fundamental research on photocatalysts for water splitting and the construction of solar hydrogen production systems".
* 2025 – August Wilhelm von Hofmann Lecture, German Chemical Society, for contributions to photocatalytic water splitting and solar-powered hydrogen production.<ref name=":3" /> 
* 2025 – Nanqiang Lecture, Xiamen University.<ref name=":3" /> 
* 2026 – Fred Kavli Distinguished Lectureship in Materials Science, Materials Research Society. Domen delivered the plenary lecture "Photocatalytic Water Splitting to Produce Solar Hydrogen and Fuels" at the 2026 MRS Spring Meeting.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kazunari Dōmen Named Fred Kavli Distinguished Lecturer in Materials Science for 2026 MRS Spring Meeting |url=https://www.mrs.org/publications-digital-content/news/article/2026/02/19/kazunari-d%C5%8Dmen-named-fred-kavli-distinguished-lecturer-in-materials-science-for-2026-mrs-spring-meeting |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=www.mrs.org |language=en}}</ref>
